<details open>

graph: pad the KV dimension of the no-cache attention to 256 (#30416)

The no-cache path builds a [n_tokens, n_tokens] mask and passes K and V
unpadded, so FLASH_ATTN_EXT sees K->ne[1] == n_tokens. The CUDA kernels
for head size 512 require a multiple of FATTN_KQ_STRIDE, so the op falls
back to the CPU for most lengths, and the -fa auto probe (1 token)
disables flash attention for such models.

Pad the mask like llama_kv_cache::get_n_kv and pad K and V with zeros up
to the KV dimension of the mask. clef builds its own causal mask and
pads it the same way.

</details>

- [macOS Intel (x64)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b11576/llama-b11576-bin-macos-x64.tar.gz)
